arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Brinkmann asserted the FAA provides exclusive grounds for vacating awards.
She stated those grounds do not include legal error.
Mr. Phillips argued the parties agreed to specific review procedures.
He noted the agreement allowed district court review after the award.

paragraphs: The case tests if the Federal Arbitration Act limits court review of arbitration awards. The Act lists specific grounds for vacating awards. Parties argue whether contracts can add new review standards.

paragraphs: The outcome defines the boundary between private arbitration and public court oversight. It determines whether parties can contractually expand judicial review of arbitration awards. This affects the finality of commercial dispute resolution.
